people.name: Benaiah
people.line: Son of Jehoiada, a mighty warrior and loyal supporter of David and Solomon.

people.name: Nathan
people.line: Prophet during the reigns of David and Solomon.

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: but he didn’t call Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother.
translations.bsb: But he did not invite Nathan the prophet, Benaiah, the mighty men, or his brother Solomon.
translations.kjv: But Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother, he called not.
translations.asv: but Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother, he called not.
